verdict.rationale: Portkey's virtual/gateway keys let a single Portkey API key grant access to multiple providers/models with provider credentials stored securely and never exposed in code, and admins can mint API keys with per-team/app budget, rate-limit, and model allow-list controls at org/workspace level. This directly matches minting gateway-managed keys without exposing raw provider keys. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and explicit detail on per-team/app key issuance workflow (only implied via workspace-level controls).
